title: Validate live inquiry master references before quotation commitment
description: Complete inquiry-to-quotation master reference integrity at the source. InquiryController creates and updates caller supplied required CustomerId, optional SalesmanId and detail ProductId after customer-scope authority, but does not resolve every supplied reference against current enabled nondeleted master rows. Add bounded batched reference validation for draft writes and live submit/approval/quotation conversion. Existing inquiry authorization decides access; do not grant or require unrelated master-maintenance menus. Preserve optional manual product snapshot lines and historical read availability without refreshing text or backfilling. Retain existing live identity/menu/customer-scope authority, transactions, source locks, controlled errors and audit. Reject before numbering or persistence, with zero header/detail/source/status mutations. No new permissions, schema, production access, external service or arbitrary SQL. Genuine SQL only on (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with Integrated Security and a fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject wrong/existing targets and never drop/reset. Require safe Release with analyzers/warnings-as-errors, full units and relevant genuine SQL/browser tests; accurately record blockers and do not claim whole-stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Require the existing required customer to resolve within current scope and reject supplied zero/negative, nonexistent/deleted/disabled customer/product/salesman references. Check eligible salesman semantics, permit nullable optional references/manual snapshot product rows only under their existing bounded text rules, and batch product loading.

Revalidate inquiry submit/approval and inquiry-to-quotation against current master records within existing row locks/transactions. Invalidated sources refuse commitment before quotation numbering or writes; preserve source and historical snapshot text with no automatic reassignment.

Rules/controller and genuine isolated SQL tests cover create/update, master invalidation between draft and commitment, approved source conversion, valid nullable/manual snapshot behavior, revoked current authority and rejected zero mutations/numbering. Adapt only genuine affected fixtures; pass safe Release/full unit regressions.
implementation_evidence: InquiryController.Create/Update persists entity.CustomerId/SalesmanId and InquiryDetail.ProductId after InquiryAuthorizationRules, with no complete live master resolver. ERP-472 guards quotation masters at the next stage but does not validate the inquiry source draft or approval. Inquiry.cs required long CustomerId and optional references establish the existing storage contract.
